memoryRule: an approach-departure changes one plane's depth and hinge, then a distant plane reconstructs itself from the wrong cast shadow
interactionRule: proximity arms only; departure, Enter, Space, or the misread control commits one bounded shadow-misread event; pointer taps are refused; Delete lifts the latest misread; release clears the theatre
representationRupture: SVG rooms, DOM cut-outs, and Canvas route -> one p5.js WebGL paper theatre of faceted planes and cast shadows
encounterRupture: click, drag, and timed double-tap -> situated approach followed by departure, with no committed pointer tap
temporalRupture: wrong doorway, vacancy/reflow, and wrong landing -> inherited shadow state that selects the next remote reconstruction
mediumRupture: deterministic inline SVG, HTML/CSS layout, and Canvas 2D -> deterministic p5.js WEBGL relief rendering
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
